newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: M.Confianca drops sharply after '96 result.
newsitem.headline: M.Confianca drops sharply after '96 result.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese insurer Mundial Confianca dropped sharply after the company's 1996 results fell short of the overly optimistic expectations of some investors, dealers said.
Mundial Confianca shares hit a low of 2,000 escudos, down 8.5 percent from the close, before clawing back to stand at 2,035 escudos, down 135, in turnover of 105,400 shares at 1425 GMT.

"Some investors did not like the 1996 results. The expectations of some investment houses were very high. People were talking of six to seven billion escudos of (net consolidated) profit," a dealer said.
Yesterday, Mundial Confianca announced a 20 percent year-on-year increase in 1996 consolidated net profit to 4.22 billion escudos.
